value.the-new-github-copilot-experience-in-sla: GitHub Copilot's AI help is now better in Slack, letting teams get assistance directly where they chat and work together.
value.shared-agentic-work-with-github-copilot-: GitHub Copilot now helps teams work together in Microsoft Teams, letting everyone share and get AI assistance on tasks.
value.copilot-memory-and-ollama-in-github-copi: GitHub Copilot now remembers your work across sessions and can use AI tools that run on your own computer, which is good for privacy.
value.github-enterprise-server-3-22-release-ca: A test version of GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is out, letting companies try new features and improvements for their private GitHub systems.
value.grok-4-6-is-now-available-in-github-copi: GitHub Copilot now offers Grok 4.6, a new AI model choice from xAI, giving you more options for AI assistance.
value.gemini-3-7-flash-is-now-available-in-git: GitHub Copilot now includes Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash, a very fast AI model, giving you another quick option for coding help.
value.mai-code-1-1-flash-available-in-github-c: GitHub Copilot now has Microsoft's MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, an updated AI model that helps with coding and improves how it works.
value.codeql-2-26-3-improves-github-actions-qu: CodeQL, a security tool, is now better at finding weaknesses in GitHub Actions and JavaScript code, making projects safer.
value.credential-revocation-and-deauthorizatio: GitHub now offers better control over who can access your accounts, letting you remove access more precisely to boost security.
